replayed catalog role flip (full replay, no filter)

cards.title: Why the replica barely notices
items: A promote does not change the content id — the new timeline lands in the segK/ dir the replica already reads
recovery_target_timeline='latest': rescanLatestTimeLine adopts the fork mid-recovery, all stock code
The old timeline's .partial segment is never needed — promotion copies the pre-fork bytes forward

cards.title: Topology stays local
items: Production's role flip replays in full into the replica's catalog copy — and is ignored there
gg_topology_source=file: the QD dispatches by $PGDATA/gg_topology, which nothing replicates
Topology writes are refused during recovery: 'cannot modify the cluster topology during recovery'

cards.title: Operational preconditions
items: archive_mode + archive_command must be preset on mirrors and standby before any failover
A node in recovery archives nothing — configured late, post-failover WAL never reaches the archive
gpactivatestandby is the same story on the coordinator content: WAL continues into seg-1/
